q0.q: What services does Quarterfold Printabilities offer?
q0.a: Quarterfold Printabilities is a fully integrated print and fulfilment company specializing in educational publishing. Our services include offset (web and sheetfed), digital printing, binding and finishing, customisation, school wise kitting and packing, warehousing, inventory management, logistics support, and end to end supply chain solutions.

q1.q: What types of books do you print?
q1.a: We print a wide range of publications including: Educational textbooks; Children's colouring and activity books; Notebooks and stationery; Teacher guides and higher education publications; Religious books; Trade books; Financial reports; Marketing collaterals; Calendars and diaries; Custom publishing projects.

q2.q: Can Quarterfold handle large printing projects?
q2.a: Yes. Quarterfold has the capability and infrastructure to manage large scale international publishing programmes. We manufacture approximately 6.5 million books per month across our 3 advanced printing facilities in Navi Mumbai, supported by a dedicated fulfilment and warehouse facility for efficient storage, packing, and distribution. With an annual production capacity of over 75 million books and exports to more than 25 countries, our integrated manufacturing and logistics capabilities enable us to deliver high volume educational and publishing projects with consistent quality, reliability, and on time execution.

q3.q: What printing technologies do you use?
q3.a: Quarterfold operates a comprehensive fleet of advanced web offset and sheet fed printing presses, supported by digital printing capabilities for specialised and short run requirements. Our diverse printing infrastructure enables us to efficiently manage projects of all sizes, from print on demand and short run printing to large scale print projects. With advanced technology, experienced teams, and robust quality control processes, we deliver consistent print quality, competitive pricing, and reliable turnaround times for publishers worldwide.

q4.q: Do you provide complete fulfilment and packing services?
q4.a: Yes. Quarterfold provides end to end fulfilment solutions beyond printing, including school wise packing, kitting, barcode labelling, shrink wrapping, palletisation, warehousing, and global distribution. We have successfully executed large scale school distribution programmes, managing school wise packing and shipment ranging from 800 schools per project to over 3,000 schools, ensuring accurate, organised, and timely delivery for complex educational programmes.

q5.a: We maintain internationally recognised certifications including: ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management); ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Information Security); FSC Certification; SEDEX. These certifications reflect our commitment to quality, sustainability, security, and ethical business practices.

q6.q: How do you ensure consistent print quality?
q6.a: Quality assurance is integrated into every stage of production. Our experienced quality control teams perform rigorous inspections throughout pre press, printing, binding, finishing, packing, and dispatch to ensure every product meets international publishing standards.

q7.q: Can Quarterfold assist with international shipping and logistics?
q7.a: Yes, we offer end to end export logistics, including documentation, container loading, freight coordination, customs support, and delivery to international destinations, ensuring a smooth supply chain from our facility to your warehouse.

q8.q: Do you support sustainable printing practices?
q8.a: Yes. Sustainability is at the core of our operations. We source paper from responsibly managed forests through FSC certified suppliers, offer recycled and sustainable paper options, and implement environmentally responsible manufacturing processes to minimise our environmental footprint. Our commitment enables publishers to meet their sustainability goals while maintaining the highest standards of quality, consistency, and performance.

q9.q: What information do I need to request a quotation?
q9.a: To prepare an accurate quotation, we typically require: Book specifications; Page count; Trim size; Print quantity; Paper specifications; Binding style; Packaging requirements; Delivery destination. Our team will guide you through the process if additional information is required.

q10.q: Do you offer sample copies or proofs before full production?
q10.a: Yes. We provide pre press proofs and physical sample copies so publishers can review the content, print quality, binding type and finishing before we proceed with full scale production.

q11.q: What paper and binding options are available?
q11.a: At Quarterfold, we are committed to sustainable printing practices and offer a wide range of paper gsm and solutions tailored to each publisher's specific requirements. Our portfolio includes recycled paper, woodfree paper, and FSC certified paper sourced from responsible suppliers to support environmental goals while maintaining excellent print quality and performance. We also provide a comprehensive range of binding options, including perfect binding, saddle stitching, case binding, and spiral binding, allowing publishers to select the ideal combination of durability, functionality, sustainability, and cost effectiveness for their projects.

q12.q: Can Quarterfold support tender based or bid based educational projects?
q12.a: Yes. Quarterfold has extensive experience supporting large scale educational projects involving government departments, Ministries of Education, international agencies, and publishers. We assist with technical and commercial documentation, specification review, production planning, and end to end execution to ensure successful project delivery.

q13.q: Do you offer warehousing and staggered delivery for large programmes?
q13.a: Yes. Quarterfold offers dedicated fulfilment and warehousing facilities totalling over 60,000 sq ft, allowing publishers and organisations to store printed materials with us without investing in their own warehouse infrastructure. We provide secure storage, inventory management, pick and pack services, and staggered delivery solutions to support large scale, multi school, and multi region programmes efficiently.

q14.q: Can Quarterfold support tender based and government funded educational projects?
q14.a: Yes. Quarterfold has extensive experience supporting and delivering large scale educational programmes involving government departments, Ministries of Education, international agencies, publishers, and donor funded organisations such as the World Bank. We provide end to end support, including technical and commercial documentation, specification review, production planning, fulfilment, and delivery, ensuring successful execution of complex projects across multiple countries while meeting strict quality and timeline requirements.

q15.q: Why should I choose Quarterfold over other printing companies?
q15.a: Quarterfold combines world class manufacturing capabilities with personalised customer service to deliver exceptional value. From pre press to final delivery, we provide a complete print and fulfilment solution backed by a decade of experience, internationally recognised certifications, advanced production facilities, and a proven track record of delivering educational programmes and publishing projects across more than 25 countries. Our competitive pricing, agile production processes, and ability to efficiently handle projects of any scale, from short runs to multi million copy print programmes, make us a trusted and reliable partner for publishers worldwide.
